introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Computer Science 2 (0595), ORDINARY LEVEL, June 2024. Duration: Two hours.**

Answer any FIVE questions. All questions carry 20 marks each. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) Mary is employed as a systems analyst in *iCom Enterprise*. Mary works regularly from her home and submits her work to her manager and also receives feedback from her manager.

(i) What is the term used to describe this work pattern? (1 mark)

(ii) Give two possible reasons that Mary might use to justify her work pattern. (2 marks)

(iii) What are the activities of Mary at *iCom Enterprise*? (2 marks)

(iv) Name and explain two computer network devices that can facilitate her work. (3 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Work pattern (1 mark).** Teleworking (also called telecommuting, or working from home / remote working).

**(ii) Two reasons (2 marks, 1 each).**

- She saves the time and money she would spend travelling to the office each day.
- A quiet home environment and flexible working hours help her concentrate and be more productive.

(Also accepted: it reduces the company's office costs, or lets her combine work with family duties.)

**(iii) Activities of a systems analyst (2 marks, 1 each).** She studies the existing system (by interviews, questionnaires, observation and reading documents), identifies its problems and the users' needs, and then designs a new or improved system and writes the specification for the programmers. She may also supervise testing and implementation, prepare documentation and train users.

**(iv) Two network devices (3 marks).**

- **Modem:** converts the digital signals of her computer into signals that can travel on the telephone or mobile line (and back), so that she can connect to the Internet and to the company's network.
- **Router:** connects her home computers to the Internet and directs the data packets (her work and the manager's feedback) to the right destination; a wireless router also lets her connect by Wi-Fi.

(A network interface card / Wi-Fi adapter is also accepted: it connects her computer to the network.)

questions.enonce_markdown:
(b) A school acquires the following items for its multimedia centre:

CRT monitors, LCD monitors, RAM chips, HDD, USB keyboards, CPU chips, scanners and cameras.

(i) Copy and complete the table below using the items above. (4 marks)

| Input devices | Output devices | Storage devices | Processing devices |
|---|---|---|---|
|  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |

(ii) Write the following abbreviations in full: RAM, LCD, CRT, HDD and USB. (5 marks)

(iii) Briefly explain the functions of

- RAM
- Scanners (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Table (4 marks, 1 mark per correct column)**

| Input devices | Output devices | Storage devices | Processing devices |
|---|---|---|---|
| USB keyboards | CRT monitors | RAM chips | CPU chips |
| Scanners | LCD monitors | HDD |  |
| Cameras |  |  |  |

(RAM is the computer's main memory, so it is placed under storage; RAM and CPU chips together may also be accepted under processing.)

**(ii) Abbreviations (5 marks, 1 mark each)**

| Abbreviation | In full |
|---|---|
| RAM | Random Access Memory |
| LCD | Liquid Crystal Display |
| CRT | Cathode Ray Tube |
| HDD | Hard Disk Drive |
| USB | Universal Serial Bus |

**(iii) Functions (2 marks, 1 each)**

- **RAM:** holds temporarily the programs and data that the CPU is using at that moment, so that the CPU can reach them quickly. It is volatile: its contents are lost when the power is switched off.
- **Scanner:** an input device that copies printed text, pictures or photographs and converts them into digital images that the computer can store, display and edit (text can be recognised with OCR software).

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) HDD is said to be read/write. Briefly explain what is meant by read/write. (1 mark)
questions.corrige_markdown: **Read/write (1 mark).** Data can be both **read** (retrieved from the disk and sent to the computer) and **written** (saved on the disk). Stored data can also be changed, erased and replaced, unlike a read-only medium such as a CD-ROM, whose contents can only be read.
